messages.subject: Failed to created shared library and no error file found
parts:
Hi all,

I tried foreach and doParallel with my code (using the complicated approach instead of nimbleMCMC). It worked on my laptop, and I tried to apply it on a Linux server. Then I got the error message "task 1 failed - Failed to create the shared library. Run 'printErrors()' to see the compilation errors." I used tryCatch to run printErrors(), but it returned "no error file found".

Since it worked on my laptop but failed on the server, I think it's because of the server instead of coding. I checked some previous questions in the group but didn't find a solution. I also want to ask what this "Failed to create the shared library" means here.

Any suggestions on this problem? 

Thanks,

Harry

messages.author: d78486bfff620d81
messages.subject: Re: Failed to created shared library and no error file found
parts:
Hi Harry,

That message means that something went wrong in compiling the C++ code that NIMBLE generates.

To debug, I would first try to run your MCMC on the Linux server without using any parallelization. If it fails, run `printErrors()` and feel free to post what you see here.

If it doesn't fail, then when parallelizing, try including `showCompilerOutput = TRUE` in your `compileNimble` calls to see if you can get it to print out the errors. (I'm not sure from your note how you're running the MCMC. Are you using `runMCMC`?)

-Chris
